architecture.mechanism: Skid mounted mobile brackish water reverse osmosis plants at different sites in Kuwait
architecture.intervention: Implement a mobile skid-mounted design that allows for easy relocation and operation across different sites in Kuwait
architecture.expected_effect: By utilizing a mobile skid-mounted system, the device can be deployed in areas with varying water quality characteristics, potentially avoiding prolonged exposure to highly scaling-prone water sources and reducing the concentration of scaling ions on membrane surfaces
architecture.falsification_test: Compare scaling rates between stationary and mobile skid-mounted RO systems operating in the same high-scaling potential water source for 12 months, measuring normalized permeate flux and membrane scaling deposits
